scene.name: The Berry Bush's Blessing
scene.text: The boy sits beside the nearly bare berry bush, touches a leaf and hums. Blossoms appear, followed by ripe berries. He immediately eats one and offers another to the youngest child nearby.

text_only.reason: rule 8: replenishing the berry bush is not a game effect; the source's own fallback is a harmless narrative version
